title: Dimensional mixer
description: Mix all the dimensions, for example now the Nether is the Overworld
body:
This mod converts or mixes dimensions.

The overworld is now the Nether, the Nether is now the End, and the End is now the overworld.

I'm working on the End because there isn't a dragon yet. You'd have to use `/summon ender_dragon` and `/setblock ~ ~ ~ end_portal` if you're playing in survival mode.

The Nether is complete.

And in the End, I mean the overworld, you'll have an underground platform. You'll get the "The End" achievement, but without a dragon or pillars. I'll change that later. Also, portals in the overworld don't work yet. If you create one, please use the command `/setblock ~ ~ ~ nether_portal`.
![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77cb9119b05292878aed6733ef105d48f4ae1673.png)

Oh, and I almost forgot that to access the natural end you have to use this command: `/execute in naturalend:natural_end_dimension run tp @s ~ ~ ~` These are the same coordinates as the overworld.

![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/365c5d8416cd0a770e9060b16d3e33c121c3a587.png)

Here's a video of the mod that's not on my channel.
